newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian industrial output 9.9 pct up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Romanian industrial output 9.9 pct up in 1996.

text.p: Romanian industrial output rose by 9.9 percent last year, slightly up from 9.4 percent growth in 1995, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Friday.
Turnover from industrial activities amounted to 68.3 trillion lei last year, with December's output at 6.8 trillion, or 4.8 percent down from the previous month.
"Industrial growth was boosted by a surge of over 27 percent in output in the machine-building sector," CNS predident Pavel Wagner told a news conference.
"The extractive sector last year stayed almost flat on the 1995 level, while light industries and the food sector slipped slightly by 2.5 percent and 2.8 respectively," he added.
Inventories soared by 50 percent last year to stand at 4.6 trillion lei at end-December.
Around 19.5 percent of the 1996 output was exported, compared with 20.4 percent the year before.
Productivity per hour went up by 12.6 percent last year compared with 14.8 percent in 1995.
Industry employed 5.634 million people at end-1996, down from 5.706 the previous year.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT DEC 96 NOV 96 DEC 95
NOTE: Figures were adjusted according to the number of working days.
